pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with varying spatial areas; edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients and low angularity, transitioning from large, elongated shapes on the upper neck to smaller, more fragmented geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pelage forming a topological graph with prominent tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pixel thickness of pathways is relatively uniform on the neck but increases in the mid-flank region.
